significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the form-(iii) conclusion that subliminal-trait transmission decreases systematically as low-probability logit structure is removed, is stronger under full-logit than hard-token distillation, and is associated with an approximately low-rank trait-aligned logit perturbation. This would establish both a behavioral phenomenon and a candidate mechanism, constraining predictions across truncation levels, temperatures, and distillation objectives rather than merely showing that a trait direction exists; it addresses the carrier left mechanistically open by Cloud et al.'s 2025 finding of trait transmission through semantically unrelated data and connects it to the tail information characterized as “dark knowledge” by Hinton et al. (2015). The branches are distinguishable: confirmation identifies the logit tail as a primary carrier, whereas failure of the linked predictions would rule out that carrier account and favor information encoded in sampled high-probability sequence structure, although mixed outcomes would make the bundled hypothesis less decisive. Topic substitution would leave only the generic question of how subliminal learning works and would not earn this score; the specific dose-response, soft-versus-hard ordering, and low-rank geometry provide the above-median increment.

reach.justification: The claim names several usable handles: “transmission-vs-truncation curves,” the “tail-perturbation rank,” and the interventions “truncation” and “hard-label distillation.” These are ex ante handles because a distillation practitioner could truncate outputs or choose hard labels before training a student, creating an action window to reduce trait leakage rather than merely explaining leakage afterward. After re-extraction on another model, the qualitative relations—more tail removal predicts less transmission and soft logits transmit more than hard tokens—would still predict what should be found, although numerical thresholds and the low-rank direction may vary with tokenizer and model; the asserted scope spans benign traits and misalignment and potentially multiple output formats, with downstream uptake by researchers and practitioners building or auditing distillation pipelines. Topic substitution would not supply these particular gating rules or forward predictions, so the reach comes from the claim rather than from subliminal learning's general importance.
